typography.name: tabular-figures
typography.value: fontFeatureSettings = tnum on every style except bodyLarge
typography.purpose: Money columns align so figures can be compared by eye.

typography.name: single-family
typography.purpose: Product UI needs one well-tuned face, not a display pairing.

motion.name: tick-flash
motion.value: 640ms tint decay on a changed row
motion.purpose: The one authored moment; marks what just changed.

motion.name: fade-through
motion.purpose: Material continuity without making a user in a task wait.

motion.name: chart-reveal
motion.value: 900ms line draw, once per data change
motion.purpose: Ends on the newest point so the motion explains chronology.

motion.name: waterfall-settle
motion.purpose: Shows each deduction taking its share of gross.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Honors the system animation setting and the Profile preference.

principles: Put the subtraction on screen: gross to net is the product's whole argument.
One accent for action; green and red mean only gain and loss.
Every rate is computed from records, never stored as a constant.
Empty states teach; error states name the recovery.
Label anything illustrative; never invent a commercial claim.
